relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — REPORT LOUDLY. This row was seeded to 'zagier2010', whose registered entry is a single-author book chapter on quantum modular forms. The attached file is a different work entirely: a two-author journal article on the descendant colored Jones polynomials, with a different byline, a different venue and a later date than the registered entry. No matching id exists in folio/schema/references.ts (searched by author pair, by subject and by the word 'descendant'), so id is set to null. RELEVANCE IS HIGH AND SPECIFIC: its abstract describes two realizations of the colored Jones polynomials — one from earlier work on quantum R-matrices at roots of unity obtained from solutions of the pentagon identity, and one as a sequence of elements of the HABIRO RING arising from the Refined Quantum Modularity Conjecture — with keywords spanning Habiro polynomials, cyclotomic expansion, ADO invariants, holomorphic quantum modular forms and q-holonomic functions. Every one of those is live QOU machinery: the Habiro-ring blocks (cor:habiro-expansion-atomic, prop:full-pole-structure-mass-trace), the quantum-modularity weight files in lean/QOU/QBeta/, and the pentagon/quantum-dilogarithm line. This is the document tying the pentagon-R-matrix and Habiro-ring routes together, which is exactly the junction QOU works at. SEPARATE FLAG on the 'zagier2010' id itself: it remains cited at mass-endomorphism/mass-modulus-em-phase-color-grading.md:31 and in two .ts cites arrays, for the claim that the bar-involution structure of the root-of-unity asymptotics is the quantum modularity of that reference. That is plausible for the work the id names, but with this file now shown not to be it, no source for the id is present in uploads/ and the claim remains unverified.

keyResults.statement: The colored Jones polynomials admit two realizations: one via quantum R-matrices at roots of unity obtained from solutions of the pentagon identity, and one as a sequence of elements of the Habiro ring arising in the Refined Quantum Modularity Conjecture.
keyResults.useForFolio: Directly joins the two routes QOU treats separately — the dilogarithm/pentagon associator line and the Habiro-ring cyclotomic-expansion line — and would source the Habiro-element framing used by the Q_beta blocks.
